info.name: SAP Concur Expense Allocations Expense Reports API

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records to return per page (max 100)

params.name: approvalStatusCode
params.description: Filter by approval status code. Valid values: A_AAFH, A_AAPH, A_ADMIN, A_APPR, A_EXTV, A_FILE, A_NOTF, A_PBDG, A_PECO, A_PEND, A_PVAL, A_RESU, A_RHLD, A_TEXP

params.name: paymentStatusCode
params.description: Filter by payment status code. Valid values: P_HOLD, P_NOTP, P_PAID, P_PAYC, P_PROC

params.name: modifiedDateBefore
params.description: Return reports modified before this date (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: modifiedDateAfter
params.description: Return reports modified after this date (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: userID
params.description: The login ID of the report owner. May only be used by company-level access token holders.

params.name: reimbursementMethod
params.description: Filter by reimbursement method. Valid values: ADPPAYR, APCHECK, AVI, CNQRPAY, PMTSERV

items.docs: Returns a collection of expense reports belonging to the current user or accessible via company-level access. Supports filtering by approval status, submission date, payment status, and reimbursement method.
Creates a new expense report header. After creating the report header, expense entries can be added using the expense entries endpoint.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the expense report

items.docs: Returns a single expense report by its ID. Includes report header information such as approval status, totals, and submission date.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the expense report

items.docs: Updates an existing expense report header. Only draft reports (not yet submitted) can be updated.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the expense report

items.docs: Deletes an expense report. Only draft reports that have never been submitted can be deleted.
